capPartition.method: Last blue cap pixel per column plus one outline row; nearest blue column fills edge columns

registration: All parts share the canonical canvas. Partition after the only whole-character resample; never resize parts independently. Base is transparent.

paintRegistration.alignment: Full generated canvas resized to approved source canvas only if needed, then the identical canonical transform. No generated bounds fitting.
paintRegistration.alpha: Every alpha byte and cap/body partition is copied from the approved canonical geometry.
paintRegistration.color: Generated RGB supplies approved pixels where both canonical alpha values are at least 240; original contour RGB is retained elsewhere. Slightly translucent interior paint remains eligible.
paintRegistration.expressions: Only RGB in the fixed eye rectangles may change, preserving all alpha.
